title: Databricks Runtime 19: September 21, 2026
body:
### New features and improvements

* **`truncate` function**: SQL and the Scala and Python DataFrame APIs now support `truncate`, which truncates a number to a specified scale without rounding.
* **`trim_array` function**: SQL and the Scala and Python DataFrame APIs now support `trim_array`, which removes elements from the end of an array when the count is positive or from the beginning when the count is negative.
* **Session environment variables for Python user-defined function workers**: Set a session-scoped Python worker environment variable using the `spark.pythonWorkerEnv.<variable-name>` configuration prefix. The variables apply when workers for regular scalar Python user-defined functions (UDFs) are launched.
* **Auto-optimized shuffle v2 enabled by default**: Auto-optimized shuffle v2 is now used when you do not set a fixed number of shuffle partitions. Workloads that explicitly set a fixed shuffle partition count are unchanged.
